name: Player Win Contribution (PWC)
description: Per-round weighted sum of each player's SHARE of their own team's output. A share is player_value / team_total for that round, so scarce actions (a lone dynamite plant) can be worth a full weight while kills are split across the team. Session total_pwc is the sum over all valid rounds.

kills.description: Share of team kills in the round

objectives.description: Share of team objective actions: completed/destroyed/stolen/returned objectives, dynamite plants+defuses, constructions (incl. MG repairs)

trade.description: Share of team trade kills (avenging a teammate within the trade window)

survival.description: Time alive vs team average, capped at 2.0x

clutch.description: Share of team clutch kills (below 30 HP or outnumbered)

zero_objective_rounds.description: When NO player in the round scored any objective action, the 0.20 objectives weight is redistributed: kills +0.06, damage +0.03, revives +0.03, survival +0.02, crossfire +0.03, trade +0.03

mvp.description: MVP is NOT the leaderboard #1. Leaderboard sorts by total_pwc (sum over all rounds); MVP is picked by waa_bayes: PWC earned in WON rounds divided by all rounds played, shrunk toward the session average with 2 phantom rounds so short-sample players cannot spike it.
mvp.eligibility: won at least 1 round AND played >= max(2, floor(max rounds played in session / 2))
mvp.fallback: if nobody qualifies, leaderboard #1 by total_pwc
